name: Aloo Chop
instructions: 1. Mash the boiled potatoes and mix them with chopped onions, green chilies, ginger-garlic paste, coriander, and salt.
2. Shape the mixture into small, flat patties.
3. Prepare a thick batter by whisking gram flour, rice flour, turmeric, chili powder, ajwain, salt, and water.
4. Heat mustard oil in a deep pan.
5. Dip each potato patty into the batter until evenly coated.
6. Carefully drop the patties into the hot oil and fry until they turn deep golden brown and crispy on both sides.
7. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with green chutney or tamarind sauce.
description: Aloo Chop is an iconic snack of Jharkhand, frequently enjoyed during monsoon evenings or as a quick street-side breakfast. It holds deep cultural roots in the region, often served alongside 'Muri' (puffed rice) as a quintessential comfort food that brings communities together.
